title: DC20 Mobile
description: Mobile and tablet support for the DC20 RPG system. When a non-GM player connects from a touch device, the desktop interface is replaced with a simplified, landscape-first UI: a Navigation tab (token movement D-pad, character switcher, targeting) and a Character tab showing the DC20 Alternative Character Sheet full-screen.

recommends.reason: The mobile Character tab displays the DC20 Alternative Character Sheet.
